messages:
olivia: Quick sync — we need to lock quotas/pricing fields for the Unified API before next sprint. Main items: per-route limits, token accounting for chat/completions, embedding unit semantics, rerank billing (per-candidate?), and function-calling metering. Also launch criteria: console UX for quotas, migration guide, and a canary plan. Thoughts? :thinking:

kevin: High-level proposal: bill most things by tokens with a model_multiplier, and add per-route override buckets for SLA routes. Example: `cost = tokens * model_multiplier`. For embeddings, charge by vector-unit where 1 unit = 1K dims normalized (so 1536-dim ~ 1.536 units). Rerank: bill per candidate scored (candidate_count * model_multiplier). Function-calls: tokens for prompt + completion + flat tool overhead (e.g., 5 token-equivalent) — avoids surprises.

maya: Customers keep asking for per-project + per-route quotas (ex: /chat/generate high QPS) and the ability to set soft-limits with alerting and auto-escalation to sales. Launch checklist from field: docs + console controls + migration FAQ + examples for billing. If we can't show per-route usage in Console at launch, enterprise customers will postpone Dedicated deals.

samir: A few technical notes: we need a canonical token counter that matches SDKs and streaming. Edge-cases: tool calls that return attachments (binary) and structured output with repeated arrays — decide if we meter by tokens only (my vote: yes) to keep it simple. Also need telemetry to report: tokens_in, tokens_out, embedding_units, rerank_candidates, function_calls_count. These fields are needed for billing reconciliation.

kevin: Implementation sketch for overrides (pseudo-config):
```
routes:
  /chat/generate:
    quota_bucket: "chat-prod"
    model_multiplier_override:
      gpt-4-lite: 1.5
  /embed/text:
    quota_bucket: "embed-prod"
```
This lets us keep global token accounting while giving per-route quotas and different multipliers.

olivia: Launch criteria (proposal):
- Billing parity: tokens + embedding_units + rerank_candidates + function_call_counts instrumented in prod metrics.
- Console: per-route usage + quota edit + alerting UI.
- Docs & migration: SDK token counting examples (stream vs non-stream), embed unit examples, and an FAQ for enterprise.
- Canary: staged rollout with 5% production traffic and automated rollback on cost regression.

maya: Prioritization note: Console per-route controls + alerting = mandatory for enterprise; bulk migration tooling is nice-to-have. If resource constrained, shift rerank granularity to MVP as "per-request" instead of per-candidate and document change.

samir: Cost modeling: run sims on customer workloads. For rerank we should provide a toggle: per-request (simpler) vs per-candidate (more accurate). Default to per-request for public launch and enable per-candidate for Dedicated/enterprise.

olivia: Decision (tentative):
- MVP: tokens billing (model_multiplier), embedding_units (per 1K-dim), rerank as per-request, function-calls billed by tokens + fixed overhead.
- Post-launch: add per-candidate rerank billing and per-route multiplier controls in API + Console.
- Required: telemetry fields and console views before GA.

product-bot: Decision doc created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PROD-1829 — "Unified API quotas and billing playbook". (link, please review).

deploy-bot: Canary change deployed to staging quotas-service at 2026-02-12T10:30:00Z — route overrides feature flag ON for team. Monitor metrics: `quota_evals`, `tokens_billed`, `embedding_units`.

kevin: I'll draft the API surface (new fields): `quota_bucket`, `route_multiplier`, `billing_tags` for enterprise invoices. Will open PR with spec and example payloads.

maya: Ack — will coordinate customer comms and migration samples. :+1:

samir: I'll add telemetry events and test vectors for token counter edge-cases.

olivia: Ok — folks, we'll reconvene in 48h after Kevin's spec PR and Samir's telemetry test results. Thanks. :eyes:
